headline: Fire on Parliament premises under control; probe committee ordered
summary: Authorities have ordered a probe committee to investigate the cause of a fire that broke out on the Parliament premises in Dhaka.
details: A fire broke out on the premises of the National Parliament building in Dhaka, causing concern at the high-security zone.
Firefighters acted quickly to bring the blaze under control, preventing it from spreading to the main building or critical infrastructure.
Following the incident, an order has been issued to form a probe committee to investigate the exact cause of the fire.
The committee will examine whether the fire was accidental or caused by negligence to ensure future safety measures are strengthened.

headline: 4 gold bars recovered from passenger's rectum at HSIA
summary: Customs officials at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport recovered four gold bars hidden inside a passenger's body.
details: Customs officials at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport (HSIA) recovered four gold bars from the rectum of a passenger arriving at the airport.
The gold bars were discovered during a routine security screening process as officials suspected the passenger of smuggling gold.
The passenger has been detained for further investigation into the smuggling operation.
Such incidents of smuggling precious metals through internal concealment are frequently reported at the airport.
